name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: PMKVY is India's flagship skill training scheme enabling youth to take up industry-relevant certification and training to secure better livelihoods.
descriptionHindi: देश के युवाओं को उद्योग-उन्मुख कौशल प्रशिक्षण देकर रोजगार एवं स्वरोजगार के बेहतर अवसर उपलब्ध कराने वाली प्रमुख योजना।
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Free industry-recognized vocational training, government certification under NSQF, accidental insurance during training, and post-placement assistance.
benefitsHindi: निःशुल्क व्यावसायिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण, सरकारी प्रमाण पत्र, प्रशिक्षण के दौरान बीमा तथा रोजगार सहायता।
eligibilityText: Indian youth aged between 15 and 45 years who are school/college dropouts or unemployed seeking industry skills.
eligibilityTextHindi: 15 से 45 वर्ष के भारतीय युवा, स्कूल/कॉलेज ड्रॉपआउट या बेरोजगार।
sourceName: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
